name: Neu-Anspach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, blue and yellow with a broad blue middle stripe, charged above the centre with the city arms of Neu-Anspach (a green tree, a rose and a bell on yellow and green).
history: Municipal flag of Neu-Anspach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neu-Anspach arms — tree, rose and bell
